newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in India kero tender from Kuwait, +$1.60.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in India kero tender from Kuwait, +$1.60.

text.p: The best offer into state-owned Indian Oil Corp's (IOC) tender to buy 40,000-45,000 tonnes of superior kerosene for July delivery was made by Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC), traders said on Friday.
KPC made the offer around $1.60 per barrel above MidEast spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast.
Traders expect IOC to limit its purchase to one cargo. The tender closed on June 5 and IOC would award it this evening.
IOC cancelled its previous kerosene import tender for June delivery.
In its tender for May deliveries, IOC bought 90,000 tonnes of kerosene in two cargoes.

The first cargo for May was awarded to Mediterranean trader BB Energy at a premium of $34.84 per tonne to Mediterranean spot quotes, c-and-f east coast, and the second cargo from Shell at the same price.
